## Outcome

Describe the user or protocol result.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests pass.
- [ ] Contract changes include fuzz/invariant impact.
- [ ] Transaction UI covers pending, confirmed, rejected, and failed states.
- [ ] Threat-model assumptions are unchanged or documented.
- [ ] Secret scan is clean.
- [ ] No real investment or personal data is included.

## Evidence

List commands, screenshots, transaction links, or test output that prove the result.
